title: pva2DGlyph
body:
## pva2DGlyph

Creates one flat 2-D marker in the x-y plane as polydata: vertex, dash, cross, thick cross, triangle, square, circle, diamond or one of four arrow styles (GlyphType, ParaView default Arrow), about one unit in size around Center. Use it as the glyph shape for 2-D vector or point-marker plots, or as an annotation symbol.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Filled only affects closed shapes (triangle, square, circle, diamond, thick variants); open shapes stay as lines.
- DoublePointed, PointInwards and TipLength only apply to the arrow glyph types.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `a2DGlyph`. Identity: `sources/GlyphSource2D`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | Set the x, y, z coordinates of the origin of the 2D glyph. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `DoublePointed` | Display double pointed arrow. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Filled` | If the value of this property is 1, the 2D glyph will be a filled polygon; otherwise, only the edges (line segments) will be included in the output. This only applies to closed 2D glyphs. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType` | This property specifies the type of the 2D glyph. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Vertex","Dash","Cross","ThickCross","Triangle","Square","Circle","Diamond","Arrow","ThickArrow","HookedArrow","EdgeArrow"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Vertex"` |
| `PointInwards` | Make the arrow tip point inwards. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `TipLength` | Length of the arrow tip. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
